REFERRAL LETTER
Date: 11/06/2026
Patient Name: Lucas Nolan
DOB: 08/27/1979
MRN: MRN-28559

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Gregory Green, Brighton Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Lucas Nolan is a 47-year-old man with essential hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus.

He reports several months of breathlessness when walking uphill or climbing stairs. It improves with rest and has gradually become more noticeable. He denies breathlessness at rest.

I would appreciate your assessment of his exertional breathlessness.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Gregory Green
Brighton Family Practice
